reader_question: In which states do renters make up the larger share of households?
title: Renters made up the larger share of households only in the District of Columbia in 2025, at 62 percent.
measure_line: Households that rent and households that own their home, as a share of all households, 50 states and the District of Columbia, 2025
notes: New York, 46 percent, and California, 44 percent, come closest among the states; every state’s renter share sits below half by more than its margin of error.
alt: Bars split each state’s households into renters and owners, sorted by the renter share, with a line at half. Only the District of Columbia’s renters, 62 percent, pass the line; New York, 46 percent, and California, 44 percent, come next, and the United States as a whole is 35 percent.

table.caption: Renters and owners as a share of households, 2025

chart_notes: The United States sits first, apart from the states. A line at the middle marks half of households; the District of Columbia’s renter share, the one past it, is set in ink and every other renter share in gray.
